clips.title: The story
paras: Duthorian Rall awaits paladins seeking trials of faith and courage in Stormwind. The Tome of Valor guides their first steps toward proving their devotion to the Church.

The Tome of Valor teaches that valor must be forged through hardship. Its sacred text compares virtues to precious ores, valuable when found but needing refinement to endure. Through hard trials and true commitment, a paladin binds faith, compassion, and courage into a strength that can resist the evils threatening Azeroth.

After reading the Tome of Valor, you are directed to Duthorian Rall, a respected leader among the paladins in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light. He hears petitions from those seeking the trials of valor. The tests are no mere ritual: defending the innocent and upholding the Church may demand your life, and only the steadfast earn recognition in the order.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Valor, and all the virtues that go along with it, are like rare minerals: you must cherish them when you find them because of their value, but you must also take time to harvest them... Refine them. When mixed together properly, a strong alloy is formed, sometimes unbreakable by even the most powerful blows.
This strength, your faith, your bravery, must be tested. You must learn to never lose faith and realize that with the power of the Light, you can overcome things that most others cannot.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, you wish to petition me for a test of valor. Splendid.
There are many tasks throughout the city and surrounding lands that hold much challenge, and they could use a friend with your skills.

This test should not be taken lightly, friend. This, like many things along our path, could take our lives. The Church always wishes to bolster its ranks, but it understands the sacrifices needed to ensure the paladins serving it are worthy.
